description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340014955767 MOUNT,RESILIENT,UTI: Line 0001 Qty 187 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0118 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
